chunks.title: Install
chunks.text: Self-host Limetry by installing the server package, setting LIMETRY_BEARER_TOKEN and JWT_SECRET, then running yarn workspace @limetry/server start. SQLite is the default local store.

chunks.title: Usage
chunks.text: Get started with the Limetry SDK by installing @limetry/sdk and calling evaluate with your agent action. Prefer the quick-start docs for first integration.

chunks.title: Security
chunks.text: Data minimization for audit means storing only decision receipts and redacted metadata. Avoid logging secrets, credentials, or full request bodies in forensics mode unless required.
